name: obsidian-second-brain
description: Gives agents persistent memory in an Obsidian vault, saving chats as linked notes and answering from them, via plugin and vault MCP.

skills.name: Save chats as notes
skills.description: Turns a chat into linked vault notes for the people, projects, decisions and tasks it mentions.

skills.name: Find in notes
skills.description: Answers questions from your own Obsidian notes, showing the context around each matching hit.
